rationale_overall: This is effectively the day-0 rebalance: the starter set (AAPL/MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA/SPY) stays intact — all five continue to show healthy Q1 2022 fundamentals (Apple's Jan 27 beat, Alphabet's 32% YoY Q4 revenue growth and split announcement) with nothing in the news window breaching their theses. Three adds fill in the profile's next-wave gaps with names that actually clear the listing-date and evidence bars as of today: RKLB (rockets & spacecraft, the top-ranked next wave, backed by a real Q4 2021 revenue beat and a Neutron/Space Force award), IONQ (quantum computing, backed by a fresh technical benchmark), and ITA (geopolitical/defense rearmament, backed by the visible post-invasion re-rating of US primes). Candidates considered and rejected on guardrails: NuScale (SMR) has not completed its SPAC merger yet (trades starting May 2022, after this date) and Rigetti (RGTI) has only ~4 weeks of trading history since its March 2, 2022 SPAC close — both too thin to add this quarter. No compelling, dated pre-3/31 catalyst surfaced for robotics, tanker/shipping, or eldercare/demographics, so those waves are left for a future rebalance.
